analyst_view.overall: Early view: bottom side Málaga, still without a league win this season, host Athletic, whose striker shortage (Guruzeta out for the season, Hierro and Sannadi injured) blunts their edge. Málaga's coaching situation may have changed by then, since two reports say Funes is under threat. Aznou's red card at home to Racing was a second yellow, which normally carries a one-match ban served at Osasuna, so he should be available here.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. Málaga score about 0.8 a game, and Athletic's attack without a No. 9 depends on the Williams brothers creating from wide. A 0-1 or 1-1 type of game looks most likely.

corners.text: The site expects 10.6 corners. Terzić's Athletic keep the ball (61% at El Sadar), and Málaga defend in a back five that invites crosses and blocks. Athletic's wide play should push the total to 11 or more.

cards.text: The model has 4.2 cards. Málaga's frustration showed against Racing with seven yellows and a red, and a side fighting relegation chasing the ball at home tends to foul more. Five cards looks closer than four.

shots.text: The site expects 28.7 shots. Athletic had 16 at Osasuna and Málaga average about 11 a game, so a total around 26 or 27 fits better.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 on target. Málaga average about three shots on target a game, and Athletic lack a finisher in the box. Seven or eight is more likely.
